clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.1 Where the game is restarted with a scrum and which team throws in is determined as follows:
clauses.law_text: Where the game is restarted with a scrum and which team throws in is determined as follows:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.2 A scrum is formed in the scrum zone at a mark indicated by the referee.
clauses.law_text: A scrum is formed in the scrum zone at a mark indicated by the referee.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.3 The referee makes the mark to create the middle line of the scrum, which runs parallel to the try lines.
clauses.law_text: The referee makes the mark to create the middle line of the scrum, which runs parallel to the try lines.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.4 Teams must be ready to form the scrum within 30 seconds of the mark being made. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Teams must be ready to form the scrum within 30 seconds of the mark being made.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.5 When both teams have 15 players, eight players from each team bind together in formation (subject to 19.7d) as suggested in the diagram. Each team must have two props and one hooker in the front row and two locks in the second row. Three back-row players from each team complete the scrum. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: When both teams have 15 players, eight players from each team bind together in formation (subject to 19.7d) as suggested in the diagram. Each team must have two props and one hooker in the front row and two locks in the second row. Three back-row players from each team complete the scrum.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.6 When a team is reduced to fewer than 15 for any reason, then the number of players in each team in the scrum may be similarly reduced. Where a permitted reduction is made by one team, there is no requirement for the other team to make a similar reduction. However, a team must not have fewer than five players in the scrum. (see also law 3.15)
clauses.law_text: When a team is reduced to fewer than 15 for any reason, then the number of players in each team in the scrum may be similarly reduced. Where a permitted reduction is made by one team, there is no requirement for the other team to make a similar reduction. However, a team must not have fewer than five players in the scrum. (see also law 3.15)

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.7 The players in the scrum bind in the following way:
clauses.law_text: The players in the scrum bind in the following way:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. The props bind to the hooker. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: The props bind to the hooker.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The players in the scrum bind in the following way:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. The hooker binds with both arms. This can be either over or under the arms of the props. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: The hooker binds with both arms. This can be either over or under the arms of the props.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The players in the scrum bind in the following way:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. The locks bind with the props immediately in front of them and with each other. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: The locks bind with the props immediately in front of them and with each other.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The players in the scrum bind in the following way:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: d. All other players in the scrum bind on a lock’s body with at least one arm. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: All other players in the scrum bind on a lock’s body with at least one arm.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The players in the scrum bind in the following way:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.8 The two groups face each other, either side of and parallel to the middle line.
clauses.law_text: The two groups face each other, either side of and parallel to the middle line.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.9 The two front rows stand not more than an arm’s length apart with the hookers at the mark.
clauses.law_text: The two front rows stand not more than an arm’s length apart with the hookers at the mark.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.10 When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “crouch”.
clauses.law_text: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “crouch”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. The front-rows then adopt a crouched position if they have not already done so. Their heads and shoulders are no lower than their hips, a position that is maintained for the duration of the scrum. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: The front-rows then adopt a crouched position if they have not already done so. Their heads and shoulders are no lower than their hips, a position that is maintained for the duration of the scrum.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “crouch”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. The front-rows crouch with their heads to the left of their immediate opponents’, so that no player’s head is touching the neck or shoulders of an opponent. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: The front-rows crouch with their heads to the left of their immediate opponents’, so that no player’s head is touching the neck or shoulders of an opponent.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “crouch”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. Hookers must have a 'brake' foot positioned to help stability and to avoid axial loading. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Hookers must have a 'brake' foot positioned to help stability and to avoid axial loading.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “crouch”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.11 When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “bind”.
clauses.law_text: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “bind”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. Each loose-head prop binds by placing the left arm inside the right arm of the opposing tight-head prop. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Each loose-head prop binds by placing the left arm inside the right arm of the opposing tight-head prop.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “bind”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. Each tight-head prop binds by placing the right arm outside the left upper arm of the opposing loose-head prop. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Each tight-head prop binds by placing the right arm outside the left upper arm of the opposing loose-head prop.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “bind”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. Each prop binds by gripping the back or side of their opponent’s jersey. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Each prop binds by gripping the back or side of their opponent’s jersey.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “bind”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: d. All players’ binding is maintained, in the position they started in, for the duration of the scrum. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: All players’ binding is maintained, in the position they started in, for the duration of the scrum.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “bind”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: e. Hookers may adjust their 'brake' foot but it must still be acting as a brake. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Hookers may adjust their 'brake' foot but it must still be acting as a brake.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the referee calls “bind”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.12 When both sides are square, stable and stationary, with the hooker still applying the brake foot, the referee calls “set”.
clauses.law_text: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, with the hooker still applying the brake foot, the referee calls “set”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. Only then must the hooker remove the 'brake' foot and the teams engage, completing the formation of the scrum and creating a tunnel into which the ball will be thrown. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Only then must the hooker remove the 'brake' foot and the teams engage, completing the formation of the scrum and creating a tunnel into which the ball will be thrown.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, with the hooker still applying the brake foot, the referee calls “set”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. All players must be in position and ready to push forward. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: All players must be in position and ready to push forward.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, with the hooker still applying the brake foot, the referee calls “set”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. Each front-row player must have both their feet on the ground, with their weight firmly on at least one foot. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Each front-row player must have both their feet on the ground, with their weight firmly on at least one foot.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, with the hooker still applying the brake foot, the referee calls “set”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: d. Each hooker’s feet must be in line with, or behind, the foremost foot of that team’s props. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Each hooker’s feet must be in line with, or behind, the foremost foot of that team’s props.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, with the hooker still applying the brake foot, the referee calls “set”.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.13 The scrum-half chooses which side of the scrum to throw in the ball.
clauses.law_text: The scrum-half chooses which side of the scrum to throw in the ball.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.14 The scrum-half holds the ball as shown in the diagram.
clauses.law_text: The scrum-half holds the ball as shown in the diagram.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.15 When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:
clauses.law_text: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. From the chosen side. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: From the chosen side.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. From outside the tunnel. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: From outside the tunnel.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. Without delay. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Without delay.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: d. With a single forward movement. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: With a single forward movement.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: e. At a quick speed. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: At a quick speed.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: f. Straight. The scrum-half may align their shoulder on the middle line of the scrum, thereby standing a shoulder-width closer to their side of the scrum. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Straight. The scrum-half may align their shoulder on the middle line of the scrum, thereby standing a shoulder-width closer to their side of the scrum.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: g. So that it first touches the ground inside the tunnel. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: So that it first touches the ground inside the tunnel.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When both sides are square, stable and stationary, the scrum-half throws in the ball:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.16 The scrum begins when the ball leaves the hands of the scrum-half.
clauses.law_text: The scrum begins when the ball leaves the hands of the scrum-half.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.17 Only when the scrum begins may the teams push. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Only when the scrum begins may the teams push.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.18 Possession may be gained by pushing the opposition backwards and off the ball.
clauses.law_text: Possession may be gained by pushing the opposition backwards and off the ball.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.19 Players may push provided they do so straight and parallel to the ground. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Players may push provided they do so straight and parallel to the ground.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.20 Front-row players may gain possession by striking for the ball but only once the ball touches the ground in the tunnel. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Front-row players may gain possession by striking for the ball but only once the ball touches the ground in the tunnel.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.21 A front-row player striking for the ball may do so with either foot but not both at the same time. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: A front-row player striking for the ball may do so with either foot but not both at the same time.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.22 The hooker from the team which threw in the ball must strike for the ball. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: The hooker from the team which threw in the ball must strike for the ball.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.23 A front-row player must not intentionally kick the ball out of the tunnel from the direction it was thrown. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: A front-row player must not intentionally kick the ball out of the tunnel from the direction it was thrown.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.24 Any player within the scrum may play the ball but only with their feet or lower legs and they must not lift the ball. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Any player within the scrum may play the ball but only with their feet or lower legs and they must not lift the ball.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.25 If a scrum collapses or if a player in the scrum is lifted or is forced upwards out of the scrum, the referee must blow the whistle immediately so that players stop pushing.
clauses.law_text: If a scrum collapses or if a player in the scrum is lifted or is forced upwards out of the scrum, the referee must blow the whistle immediately so that players stop pushing.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.26 When the scrum is stationary and the ball has been available at the back of the scrum for three-five seconds, the referee calls “use it”. The team must then play the ball out of the scrum immediately. Sanction: Scrum.
clauses.law_text: When the scrum is stationary and the ball has been available at the back of the scrum for three-five seconds, the referee calls “use it”. The team must then play the ball out of the scrum immediately.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.27 Players remain onside for the duration of the scrum. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Players remain onside for the duration of the scrum.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.28 Prior to the start of play in the scrum, the scrum-half of the team not throwing in the ball stands:
clauses.law_text: Prior to the start of play in the scrum, the scrum-half of the team not throwing in the ball stands:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. On that team’s side of the middle line next to the opposing scrum-half, or Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: On that team’s side of the middle line next to the opposing scrum-half, or
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Prior to the start of play in the scrum, the scrum-half of the team not throwing in the ball stands:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. At least five metres behind the hindmost foot of their team’s last player in the scrum and remains there until the completion of the scrum. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: At least five metres behind the hindmost foot of their team’s last player in the scrum and remains there until the completion of the scrum.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Prior to the start of play in the scrum, the scrum-half of the team not throwing in the ball stands:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.29 Once play in the scrum begins, the scrum-half of the team in possession has at least one foot level with or behind the ball.
clauses.law_text: Once play in the scrum begins, the scrum-half of the team in possession has at least one foot level with or behind the ball.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.30 Once play in the scrum begins, the scrum-half of the team not in possession:
clauses.law_text: Once play in the scrum begins, the scrum-half of the team not in possession:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. Takes up a position near the scrum with both feet no further than the centre line of the tunnel, or Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Takes up a position near the scrum with both feet no further than the centre line of the tunnel, or
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Once play in the scrum begins, the scrum-half of the team not in possession:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. Permanently retires to a point on the offside line either at that team’s hindmost foot, or Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Permanently retires to a point on the offside line either at that team’s hindmost foot, or
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Once play in the scrum begins, the scrum-half of the team not in possession:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. Permanently retires at least five metres behind the hindmost foot. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Permanently retires at least five metres behind the hindmost foot.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Once play in the scrum begins, the scrum-half of the team not in possession:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.31 All players not participating at the scrum remain at least five metres behind the hindmost foot of their team. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: All players not participating at the scrum remain at least five metres behind the hindmost foot of their team.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.32 When the hindmost foot of a team is in in-goal or within five metres of that team’s try line, the offside line for that team’s non-participants is the try line. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: When the hindmost foot of a team is in in-goal or within five metres of that team’s try line, the offside line for that team’s non-participants is the try line.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.33 As soon as the scrum ends, offside lines no longer apply.
clauses.law_text: As soon as the scrum ends, offside lines no longer apply.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.34 When there is no infringement, the referee will stop play and reset the scrum if:
clauses.law_text: When there is no infringement, the referee will stop play and reset the scrum if:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. The scrum-half throws in the ball and it comes out at either end of the tunnel.
clauses.law_text: The scrum-half throws in the ball and it comes out at either end of the tunnel.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When there is no infringement, the referee will stop play and reset the scrum if:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. The scrum collapses or breaks up before it has otherwise ended.
clauses.law_text: The scrum collapses or breaks up before it has otherwise ended.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When there is no infringement, the referee will stop play and reset the scrum if:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. The scrum is wheeled through more than 90 degrees, so the middle line has passed beyond a position parallel to the touchline.
clauses.law_text: The scrum is wheeled through more than 90 degrees, so the middle line has passed beyond a position parallel to the touchline.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When there is no infringement, the referee will stop play and reset the scrum if:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: d. Neither side wins possession.
clauses.law_text: Neither side wins possession.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When there is no infringement, the referee will stop play and reset the scrum if:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: e. The ball is unintentionally kicked out of the tunnel. Exception: If the ball is repeatedly kicked out, the referee must treat this as intentional. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: The ball is unintentionally kicked out of the tunnel. Exception: If the ball is repeatedly kicked out, the referee must treat this as intentional.
clauses.sanction_qualification_quote: Exception: If the ball is repeatedly kicked out, the referee must treat this as intentional.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: When there is no infringement, the referee will stop play and reset the scrum if:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.35 When a scrum is reset, the ball is thrown in by the team that previously threw it in.
clauses.law_text: When a scrum is reset, the ball is thrown in by the team that previously threw it in.

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.36 The scrum ends:
clauses.law_text: The scrum ends:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. When the ball comes out of the scrum in any direction except the tunnel.
clauses.law_text: When the ball comes out of the scrum in any direction except the tunnel.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The scrum ends:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. When the ball reaches the feet of the hindmost player and it is picked up by that player or is played by that team’s scrum-half.
clauses.law_text: When the ball reaches the feet of the hindmost player and it is picked up by that player or is played by that team’s scrum-half.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The scrum ends:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. When the number eight picks up the ball from the feet of a second-row player.
clauses.law_text: When the number eight picks up the ball from the feet of a second-row player.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The scrum ends:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: d. When the referee blows the whistle for an infringement.
clauses.law_text: When the referee blows the whistle for an infringement.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The scrum ends:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: e. When the ball in a scrum is on or over the try line.
clauses.law_text: When the ball in a scrum is on or over the try line.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: The scrum ends:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.37 Dangerous play in a scrum includes:
clauses.law_text: Dangerous play in a scrum includes:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. A front-row charging against the opposition. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: A front-row charging against the opposition.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Dangerous play in a scrum includes:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. Pulling an opponent. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Pulling an opponent.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Dangerous play in a scrum includes:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. Intentionally lifting an opponent off their feet or forcing them upwards out of the scrum. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Intentionally lifting an opponent off their feet or forcing them upwards out of the scrum.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Dangerous play in a scrum includes:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: d. Intentionally collapsing a scrum. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Intentionally collapsing a scrum.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Dangerous play in a scrum includes:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: e. Intentionally falling or kneeling. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Intentionally falling or kneeling.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Dangerous play in a scrum includes:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.38 Other restricted practices at a scrum include:
clauses.law_text: Other restricted practices at a scrum include:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: a. Falling on or over the ball immediately after it has emerged from the scrum. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Falling on or over the ball immediately after it has emerged from the scrum.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Other restricted practices at a scrum include:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: b. Scrum-half kicking the ball while it is in the scrum. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Scrum-half kicking the ball while it is in the scrum.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Other restricted practices at a scrum include:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: c. Non-front-row player holding or pushing an opponent. Sanction: Penalty.
clauses.law_text: Non-front-row player holding or pushing an opponent.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Other restricted practices at a scrum include:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: d. Bringing the ball back into the scrum once it has left. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Bringing the ball back into the scrum once it has left.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Other restricted practices at a scrum include:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: e. Non-front-row players playing the ball in the tunnel. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Non-front-row players playing the ball in the tunnel.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Other restricted practices at a scrum include:

clauses.section: Dangerous play and restricted practices in a scrum
clauses.raw_paragraph_text: f. Scrum-half attempting to make an opponent believe the ball is out of the scrum when it is not. Sanction: Free-kick.
clauses.law_text: Scrum-half attempting to make an opponent believe the ball is out of the scrum when it is not.
clauses.inherited_parent_context: Other restricted practices at a scrum include:

clauses.raw_paragraph_text: 19.39 A union may implement the under-19 scrum law variations at defined levels of the game within its jurisdiction.
clauses.law_text: A union may implement the under-19 scrum law variations at defined levels of the game within its jurisdiction.
